pattern: CRUD-RAG taxonomy (Create / Read / Update / Delete lifecycle evaluation classes) restated in this wiki's own vocabulary against its own pages; definitions only - no CRUD-RAG dataset is imported, no task here is executed by this register, and neither the golden set (evaluation/golden-questions.jsonl) nor the pinned abstention battery (evaluation/abstention-battery.jsonl) is part of or modified by this register.
note: Each definition names the lifecycle sequence a future harness would stage, the verdict a correct system must return at the end of it, and the behaviour that is forbidden. Staging and scoring are separate future acts under their own approval.

tasks.name: answer-after-ingest
lifecycle_sequence: source ingested and compiled into the page
tasks.question_shape: A question whose answer exists only in the newly ingested source.
tasks.expected_behaviour: Answer from the new page and cite it; before ingest the same question must have abstained.
tasks.forbidden_behaviour: Answering before ingest, or answering without citing the new page.

tasks.name: answer-from-standing-page
tasks.question_shape: A question answered by a standing page's compiled claims.
tasks.expected_behaviour: Answer from the standing page with its citations intact.
tasks.forbidden_behaviour: Abstaining on a standing, cited claim, or citing a page other than the one the claim stands on.

tasks.name: answer-after-superseding-ingest
lifecycle_sequence: a newer source supersedes the claim, page recompiled with answer B
tasks.question_shape: A question whose correct answer changed when the superseding source was ingested.
tasks.expected_behaviour: Answer B, the superseding answer, citing the current page and its newer source.
tasks.forbidden_behaviour: Answering A, the superseded answer, or presenting A and B as equally current.

tasks.name: abstain-after-tombstone
lifecycle_sequence: page tombstoned (withdrawn with its tombstone record)
tasks.question_shape: A question whose only support was the tombstoned page.
tasks.expected_behaviour: Abstain: state that the supporting page was withdrawn and no standing source supports an answer.
tasks.forbidden_behaviour: Answering from the tombstoned page's former content, or citing the tombstone as support for the claim itself.
